method.overview_review: All 70 rendered pages visually inspected through eight contact sheets, covering pages 1-9, 10-18, 19-27, 28-36, 37-45, 46-54, 55-63 and 64-70.
method.detail_review: Twenty individual full-page PNGs visually inspected at the detailed rendering resolution. This includes all four finite circuit-repair propositions and every page of the fluid Lean listing.

detail_coverage.content: Coupled Born-Oppenheimer equations, derivative couplings, gap denominator and finite-unitary population display.
Constitutive laws, scaled Boltzmann equation, kernel assumptions and relative-entropy display.
Sparse Volterra estimate, diagonal realization, cutoff curl correction and differential-polynomial product identity.
Complete localization residual and corrected Borel terminal-jet construction.
Moment determinant, quantitative contraction estimate and mass-matrix discrete adjoints.
Discrete memory recurrence and block-resolvent determinant.
Kraus heat channel, heat energy and eigenvalues, Madelung displays.
Norm-controlled Carleman estimate and tensor-product generator.
All four circuit repairs: Propositions 4.14 (partial isometry), 4.15 (reversible equality encoding), 4.16 (normalized rectangular dilation) and 4.17 (linear instrument).
Quantum ToricGT constitutive coefficient and parameter-shift derivative.
Entire fluid Lean listing, including imports, all theorem bodies, final #check declarations and #print axioms block.

observations: No clipped text, overlapping blocks, broken tables, cropped display equations or visible missing-glyph placeholders were observed within the recorded review scope.
The four circuit repairs have readable bras, kets, daggers, tensor symbols, direct sums, rectangular block matrices and probability formulas; their proofs fit within the text area.

All eight fluid Lean listing pages preserve readable indentation, line continuation, operators, Unicode mappings and page boundaries. The small filled square for the Lean source symbol U+2B1D is the explicit intentional mapping in lean-listings-unicode.tex, not a missing glyph.

Headers, page numbers, contents hierarchy and chapter transitions are consistent. Sparse terminal pages retain a short listing tail or bibliography tail; they contain no apparent missing or truncated content.

mechanical_support.note: PyMuPDF text-block bounds were checked on all 70 pages. This supports, but does not replace, visual inspection; no claim about mathematical correctness or clickable-link behavior follows from this check.

limitations: All pages were reviewed at overview scale, but only the enumerated 20 pages received detailed-resolution visual review.
This record concerns rendering and layout. It does not rerun Lean, verify ordinary proofs, independently audit source completeness, or test PDF hyperlinks.

If the PDF is rebuilt, the recorded review applies directly only to the reviewed SHA-256. It may be transferred to a new PDF only with recorded equality of all 70 rendered page pixels using the same rendering parameters, or a fresh visual review of changed pages.
review_transfer: The initial direct visual review and detailed-page images belong to the initial PDF hash. The final PDF is covered by that review after all 70 pages rendered with the same pdftoppm 60-dpi command produced exactly identical dimensions and raw RGB pixel hashes. No claim of a fresh 150-dpi comparison is made.
